title: Create a PKG build for OCTR-NitroFueled-PC
body: Create a Pkg build for https://github.com/Ryu7w7/OCTR-NitroFueled-PC I made my own PKGBUILD but i can't register to AUR site. pkgname=OCTR-NitroFueled-PC-bin pkgver="0.6.3" pkgrel="1" pkgdesc="Experimental Online Crash Team Racing: Nitro-Fueled (PS4) running natively on Windows 10/11. Windows fork of SacredFire, built on bbport and shadPS4. No game files included." arch=('x86_64') url="https://github.com/Ryu7w7/OCTR-NitroFueled-PC" source=(https://github.com/Ryu7w7/OCTR-NitroFueled-PC/releases/download/v${pkgver}/SacredFire-v${pkgver}-x86_64.AppImage) sha256sums=('c75618255815ae7029f144fb53fa05c4867ff267e4eac18b46b9b5903cfdd6ee') license=('GNU General Public License v2.0') package() { chmod u+x ${srcdir}/SacredFire-v${pkgver}-x86_64.AppImage ${srcdir}/SacredFire-v${pkgver}-x86_64.AppImage --appimage-extract mkdir -p ${pkgdir}/usr/bin/nix mkdir -p ${pkgdir}/usr/share/applications mkdir -p ${pkgdir}/usr/bin/mountroot/nix/store cp -P -r ${srcdir}/squashfs-root/nix ${pkgdir}/usr/bin/ cp -P -r ${srcdir}/squashfs-root/usr ${pkgdir}/ cp -P -r ${srcdir}/squashfs-root/entrypoint ${pkgdir}/usr/bin/ cp -P -r ${srcdir}/squashfs-root/AppRun ${pkgdir}/usr/bin/sacredfire cp -P -r ${srcdir}/squashfs-root/io.github.sacredfire.Launcher.desktop ${pkgdir}/usr/share/applications/io.github.sacredfire.Launcher.desktop } Last edited by HyperPuppy (2026-10-22 09:39:35)
